description: Returns a linked income statement, balance sheet and cash flow for each projected year, seeded from the company's latest annual 10-K figures, with a yearly check that the balance sheet balances and the free cash flow stream. Use this when the user wants to see how a company's statements could develop under growth, margin, financing and payout assumptions they choose. Margins and capital spending stay at the latest year's share of revenue unless overridden; interest and tax rates are the user's assumptions.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time cutoff for the reported inputs, YYYY-MM-DD: only filings accepted by this date, e.g. 2024-06-30.

capex_pct_of_revenue_override.description: Capital spending as a share of revenue; omit to keep the latest year's, e.g. 0.03.

cash_sweep_pct.description: Share of each year's free cash flow used to repay debt, 0 to 1; defaults to 0, e.g. 0.5.

dividend_payout_pct.description: Share of each year's net income distributed as dividends, 0 to 1; defaults to 0, e.g. 0.3.

gross_margin_pct_override.description: Gross margin for every projected year; omit to keep the latest year's, e.g. 0.45.

interest_rate_on_debt.description: Interest rate on debt at the start of each year, 0 to 0.5; defaults to 0.06, e.g. 0.05.

new_debt_draw_year1.description: New debt borrowed in the first projected year, in USD; defaults to 0, e.g. 5000000000.

new_equity_draw_year1.description: New equity raised in the first projected year, in USD, added to cash and equity; defaults to 0, e.g. 2000000000.

operating_margin_pct_override.description: Operating margin for every projected year; omit to keep the latest year's, e.g. 0.3.

revenue_growth_rate.description: Yearly revenue growth as a decimal, -0.5 to 1, e.g. 0.08.

tax_rate.description: Tax rate on positive pretax income, 0 to 1; defaults to 0.21, e.g. 0.25.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol or SEC CIK of the company to project, e.g. AAPL.

years.description: Years to project, 1 to 15; defaults to 5, e.g. 10.

name: project_three_statement

_meta.description: Provenance envelope — data lineage for every MCP response

data_quality.description: Server-side invariants run on this response

fundamentals_as_of.description: Use THIS — not `last_updated` — when telling a user how current the cross-sectional fundamentals are. The snapshot is republished on every weekday price refresh while the statements are carried forward unchanged, so `last_updated` can be far more recent than the numbers it sits next to. It is a floor for a single filer, not a ceiling: a filer with a live partition receives its filing, facts and ratios intraday (minutes after EDGAR dissemination), so an entity-scoped read may carry a filing newer than this; cross-sectional ranks (factor scores, earnings signals) refresh with the weekly bulk export.

pit_safe.description: true iff a zero-look-ahead point-in-time cut was applied to every returned figure

price_as_of.description: ISO timestamp when the price surfaces were last refreshed.

truncation.description: Set when fewer rows were returned than requested — explains why and points to a remedy
